results.answer:
Dr. Rabeeh Ayaz Abbasi is a tenured professor at the Department of Computer Science, Quaid-i-Azam University, Islamabad, Pakistan. [1]

Dr. Rabeeh Ayaz Abbasi has a PhD in Computer Science from the Institute of Web Science and Technologies (WeST), University of Koblenz-Landau, Germany. [1]

Dr. Rabeeh Ayaz Abbasi's research focuses on leveraging positive aspects of social media, including social media’s use in saving lives, understanding events, and analyzing sentiments. [1]

Dr. Rabeeh Ayaz Abbasi has supervised a number of BS, MS, and PhD theses. [2]

Dr. Rabeeh Ayaz Abbasi's research interests include Data Science, Machine Learning on Graphs, Network Science, Social Media Analytics, and Social Network Analysis. [2]
